note.en: For the table download in XLSX, CSV, and FLAT formats, the output of quality symbols (), p, r, and s can be disabled by the checkbox in the download dialog. The quality symbols that are listed in the explanation of symbols are all potentially occurring quality symbols that are not necessarily occuring in the present table.
